transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: Metro line 9 (University zone — Airport) stops at both terminals: Aeroport T1 station in terminal T1 on Level 0 and a station in terminal T2 on Level 0. A free shuttle runs between the terminals round the clock.

taxi.title: Taxi
taxi.text: Taxi ranks are opposite the arrivals areas of terminal T1, the Barcelona–Madrid shuttle corridor and terminals T2A, T2B and T2C; each has a queue for unbooked rides and a spot for pre-booked cars. In terminal T1 official taxis are on Level 0. The only official taxi in Barcelona is black and yellow.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: Airport Free Wifi Aena network: log in on the start page with your email address as a guest or with an Aena Club account. You get 15 minutes of free internet to confirm your email; once it is confirmed, access has no time limit.
